title: Configuration padding
statement: Given a configuration on $k$ Boolean work tapes and a natural number $K$, define a configuration on $K$ work tapes with the same state, input head position, and output. Its first $k$ work tapes and head positions are retained, while any additional tapes are blank and have their heads at position zero.
hypotheses_covered: A configuration on $k$ Boolean work tapes with state set $S$ and fixed Boolean input
A natural number $K$ specifying the padded number of work tapes
